_doc: DEWY receipts for 2026-08-11 — MERGED across concurrent sessions (witness + federated-family/drift-receipt). See ADR-046 (witness) and ADR-050/051/052.

receipts.sharp_question: When a flash of brilliance crystallizes mid-conversation, how do we attest to it honestly instead of reconstructing it later?

dewy_vector.D: Build /witness: a one-shot, verbatim, timestamped capture with an honest gut-check Y, appended to _STATE/witness/<date>.jsonl. WORLD.md carries the proactive trigger (THE WITNESS, beside the Drift Sentinel) so Claude offers it unprompted at the moment it notices the signal.
dewy_vector.W: DURABLE. Revisit after a few days of real firings — whether to wire into /night-moves.

receipts.true_north: Attest at the moment it happens, not at handoff — a reconstructed witness is the same dishonesty ADR-044 gates on the aspiration side.
receipts.why: Zach asked directly whether a flash of brilliance deserves a scribe ("can I get a witness"); no existing mechanism captures live, only after-the-fact (DEWY at decision time, night-moves at day's end).
receipts.loki: A third parallel logging surface fragments 'where do I look'? Mitigated by distinct non-overlapping timescales (moment/decision/day) and explicitly NOT wiring into night-moves yet.
receipts.bar: Low — an unpromoted witness stub costs nothing; the risk is over-firing (ceremony fatigue), mitigated by 'deliberately rare' instruction in both WORLD.md and the command.

receipts.sharp_question: How to ship the canon artifacts publicly without leaking the client book?

dewy_vector.D: Two layers, one air-gap: SSOT truth feeds prospect-safe faces; meta-audit stays private.

receipts.sharp_question: How do we learn from architecture decay, not just block it?

dewy_vector.D: Every gate is a detector; every failure is a receipt (PR tripwire + deploy rollback+Issue).

receipts.outcome: gate live; caught first receipt (forge-page jargon)

receipts.sharp_question: Who keeps an owner-less artifact up to date?

dewy_vector.D: An inchworm auditor: orient at open, advance at close; regen mechanical, receipt the judgment.

receipts.outcome: lattice SSOT 32->44; live surface re-embedded + verified
